name: Alisver Incident
source:
A tragedy has befallen the Alisvers, the descendants of a famous movie star couple from the past. On their own private island, by the hands of their own family, twelve kids was attacked. Few died, the rest went missing.

Nova and Raiha, two highschool students who are blessed with nature's power, was roped to investigate the Alisvers case by someone they just met.  They had to inspect the island and bring home the survivors of manslaughter, if there's any.  Also, the Alisvers are totally not cursed, not at all.

[From [url=https://radiokiro.itch.io/alisver-incident]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场悲剧降临在阿利斯弗夫妇身上，他们是昔日著名电影明星夫妇的后裔。在他们自己的私人岛屿上，十二个孩子遭到了自己家人的袭击。很少有人死亡，其余的都失踪了。

诺瓦（Nova）和雷哈（Raiha）是两名拥有自然力量的高中生，他们被刚认识的人拉去调查阿利斯弗斯案。他们必须检查该岛并带回过失杀人的幸存者（如果有的话）。而且，阿利斯弗一家完全没有被诅咒，一点也没有。

[来自[url=https://radiokiro.itch.io/alisver-incident]Itch.io[/url]]
